---
title: "Datashading a million points"
description: "Aggregate-then-shade rendering that stays fast and legible at a million points."
categories: [Big data]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

A scatter of a million points is just ink. `mark_datashade()` uses vellum's
built-in datashader-style fast path: aggregate points into a pixel grid, then
shade by density, so the picture scales with the canvas, not the data.

```{r}
set.seed(1)
n <- 1e6
df <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), y = rnorm(n) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.4))

p <- vplot(df) |>
  mark_datashade(x = x, y = y) |>
  labs(title = "One million points, datashaded")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "datashade")
```
